record.question: Who has been elected as the new CEO of the International Cricket Council?
record.explanation: Answer C: Manu Sawhney. ICC announced Manu Sawhney’s appointment on 15 January 2019. Its 1 April 2019 notice says he became ICC’s fifth chief executive, succeeding David Richardson. Thus Manu Sawhney is correct at this April 2019 paper. The ICC Board ratified an appointment; the stem’s elected is loose wording. Historical/source note: Appointed/assumed office as ICC chief executive in 2019, rather than elected by a public vote; not an assertion about the current incumbent. Reference: https://www.icc-cricket.com/news/manu-sawhney-icc-ceo; https://www.icc-cricket.com/media-releases/manu-sawhney-named-as-icc-chief-executive. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
